parameters.content:
## W38 SMC lead alert (owner), 18 Oct 2026
Every minute: new SortMyCover leads (public.leads) and bookings (public.appointments) since the watermark in this workflow's static data -> ONE plain-text message to Jono through EMMA (POST https://emmadoesit.cloud/api/notify, x-emma-secret; EMMA answers 200 delivered, 502 not).
- First run: watermark = the database's now(), nothing sent (history is never replayed). Each tick re-reads a 5-minute overlap and skips ids already sent (de-dupe map, at most 200).
- The watermark moves only after a 2xx; a failed send is retried on the next tick; the 3rd failure in a row fails the run once, so W22 emails ops.
- POPIA: first name, the last 3 digits of the number, source / ad angle, the routed practice, booking time (SAST) and method. Never email, the full number, ID numbers or message text.
- Test / real split (23 Oct 2026): each line says TEST practice / real adviser and [test data]; WRONG SIDE flags an item routed across the line; a top warning when SMC_TEST_BROKER_IDS names an id that is no broker.
Env: SMC_LEAD_ALERT_ENABLED=true (anything else: nothing runs and the state is dropped), EMMA_SHARED_SECRET, DRY_RUN_SENDS (true: logged, not posted); SMC_TEST_BROKER_IDS / SMC_TEST_PHONES / SYNTHETIC_TEST_NUMBERS for the labels.

parameters.query:
-- W38 SMC lead alert: SortMyCover leads + bookings created after the window start (the watermark minus the overlap;
-- empty on the first run, so no rows, only now()). Only a first name, the last 3 digits of the number, attribution labels,
-- the routed practice and the booking time + method leave the database: never email, the full number or message text.
-- Test / real split: test_lead + test_practice (booleans) per item; split_unknown_ids = an SMC_TEST_BROKER_IDS id is no broker.
SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS db_now,
       CASE WHEN coalesce($3, '') = '' THEN false
            ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.brokers b WHERE b.id::text = ANY (string_to_array($3, ','))) < cardinality(string_to_array($3, ',')) END AS split_unknown_ids,
       coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(u.j ORDER BY u.t) FROM (
         SELECT t, j FROM (
           SELECT l.created_at AS t, jsonb_build_object(
                    'kind', 'lead', 'id', l.id, 'created_at', l.created_at,
                    'first_name', split_part(btrim(coalesce(l.first_name, '')), ' ', 1),
                    'phone_last3', right(regexp_replace(coalesce(l.phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 3),
                    'origin', l.origin, 'angle', l.angle, 'utm_campaign', l.utm_campaign, 'utm_content', l.utm_content, 'ref', l.ref,
                    'practice', b.practice_name, 'repeat', l.duplicate_of IS NOT NULL, 'synthetic', l.is_synthetic,
                    'test_lead', coalesce(l.is_synthetic, false) OR coalesce(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(l.phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '^00', ''), '^0([0-9]{9})$', '27\1') = ANY (string_to_array(nullif($4, ''), ',')), false),
                    'test_practice', CASE WHEN coalesce($3, '') = '' OR l.broker_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE l.broker_id::text = ANY (string_to_array($3, ',')) END) AS j
             FROM public.leads l
             LEFT JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = l.broker_id
            WHERE l.brand_id = $1::uuid AND l.created_at > nullif($2, '')::timestamptz
           UNION ALL
           SELECT a.created_at, jsonb_build_object(
                    'kind', 'booking', 'id', a.id, 'created_at', a.created_at, 'at', a.appointment_date, 'method', a.method,
                    'status', a.status, 'rebooked', a.previous_booking_id IS NOT NULL,
                    'first_name', split_part(btrim(coalesce(l.first_name, '')), ' ', 1),
                    'phone_last3', right(regexp_replace(coalesce(l.phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 3),
                    'practice', b.practice_name, 'synthetic', coalesce(l.is_synthetic, false),
                    'test_lead', coalesce(l.is_synthetic, false) OR coalesce(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(l.phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '^00', ''), '^0([0-9]{9})$', '27\1') = ANY (string_to_array(nullif($4, ''), ',')), false),
                    'test_practice', CASE WHEN coalesce($3, '') = '' OR a.broker_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE a.broker_id::text = ANY (string_to_array($3, ',')) END)
             FROM public.appointments a
             LEFT JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = a.client_id
             LEFT JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = a.broker_id
            WHERE a.brand_id = $1::uuid AND a.created_at > nullif($2, '')::timestamptz
         ) x ORDER BY t LIMIT 200) u), '[]'::jsonb) AS items;
